title: Praxa：面向受治理AI智能体执行的证据约束框架
summary: Praxa是一个智能体执行框架，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账与审核晋升，显式区分提案、授权、派发与已验证效果。论文报告四条证据线，但未证明其优于基线，核心贡献是使授权到效果的转换可测试。
summary_en: Praxa is an agent harness that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable via deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. Four evidence lanes show no superiority over baselines; its supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture.
